title: Vented decorative appliances and room heaters.
officialText:
Shutoff valves for vented decorative appliances, room heaters and
decorative appliances for installation in vented fireplaces shall be permitted to be installed in an area remote from the appliances
where such valves are provided with ready access. Such valves shall be permanently identified and shall serve no other appliance. The
piping from the shutoff valve to within 6 feet (1829 mm) of the appliance shall be designed, sized and installed in accordance with
Sections 401 through 408.
